key_insight: A noise-aware emulator can propagate dominant hardware imperfections through the full analog quantum computation cycle and accurately predict neutral-atom processor behavior.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical validation and design tool for analog quantum hardware, helping engineers diagnose error sources and improve algorithm-device co-design.
method: Model dominant noise mechanisms across the full computation pipeline
Benchmark quantum annealing and post-quench dynamics on three Pasqal processors
Compare emulator predictions with classical ground truth and measured observables
evidence_signal: Across three devices, the measured observables fell within the emulator’s predicted uncertainty envelopes for both benchmark protocols.
watch_item: The framework is validated where classical simulation is still available, so performance in truly beyond-classical regimes still needs independent verification.
paper_title: Noise-aware emulation and cross-device validation of neutral atom analog quantum processing units
